subject: English

source.name: CISCE Curriculum for Classes I-V (English), Primary

notes: Skill-based, 3 strands per class + shared English Literature reading list (Cl I & II). Subtopics verbatim from Learning Outcomes/Suggested Content.

chapters.name: Listening and Speaking
subtopics: Comprehend a text read aloud and answer questions

chapters.name: Reading and Writing
subtopics: Read with the help of pictures
Group and individual reading with understanding
Capital letter to begin, full stop to end
Write 8-10 lines on a given topic
Draw and write on a familiar topic
Dictation of three/four-letter words and small sentences

chapters.name: Grammar and Vocabulary in Context
subtopics: Naming, action, describing and position words with opposites
Punctuation: capitals, commas, full stops, ? and !
